Best meal I had in a very long time
Feb 2020 • Couples
Really awesome place to eat !!
The food is incredibly tasty, sophisticated and has a great balance of Asian cuisine with a Spanish touch (very well presented as well). 
Service is very tentative, the decor is lovely and the overall ambience is great (I personally really enjoyed the soundtrack and the space is well air conditioned so it’s a great break from the sweltering heat). 
Me and my wife ordered a number of tapas dishes , a salad and a main which was plenty to make us full and happy.
The owners/management are very nice to talk to (if you feel like talking, they are not over engaging if you simply feel like eating in peace) and seem to know a lot about food.
The ingredients are of top quality and you can taste the fresheners in the food (the restaurant has its own herb garden which is really cute). 
The prices are very reasonable and there is an overall great value for what you pay so I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who is looking for a great meal in Ho Chi Minh City
